semantics: Status of the construction/refurbishment phase represented by the pin, at its milestone or latest sourced check. Completion of an announcement, financing or approval is not project completion. Historical opening/return pins retain Completed even if the facility later shuts. Shutdown, accident, sale and storage events are excluded unless they explicitly begin a physical refurbishment phase.

pins.title: Palisades Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: DOE Closes Palisades Restart Loan Guarantee
pins.evidence: DOE closes financing of up to USD 1.52 billion. The loan amount is not represented as the total project cost.

pins.title: Palisades Returns from Decommissioning to Operations Status
pins.evidence: The regulatory status changes after licensing approvals. This authorizes the restart process, not a completed return to electricity production.

pins.title: Palisades Begins Loading Fuel for Its Proposed Restart
pins.evidence: Holtec begins reactor fuel loading, with testing and startup steps still ahead.

pins.title: Holtec Recovers Tilted Fuel Assembly at Palisades
pins.evidence: Holtec reports retrieval of the tilted assembly and transfer to the spent-fuel pool, removing a significant restart obstacle.

pins.title: Palisades Restart Remains Conditional After Fuel-Assembly Recovery
pins.evidence: No completed generating restart is verified. March 31 is the existing contract-backstop timeline marker, not an announced restart day; Holtec reported fuel recovery October 21.

pins.title: Duane Arnold Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Google and NextEra Announce Duane Arnold Restart Agreement
pins.evidence: A 25-year Google agreement supports the proposed 615 MW restoration, targeted for full operation in the first quarter of 2029.

pins.title: DOE Closes Up-to-$1.9 Billion Loan for Duane Arnold Restart
pins.evidence: The financing closes September 8, according to the dated DOE release. This is not total capital cost or permission to generate.

pins.title: Duane Arnold Targets Full Operation by First Quarter 2029
pins.evidence: The operator retains a Q1 2029 target, conditional on NRC approval. March 31 is a quarter-end timeline anchor, not a scheduled startup day.

pins.title: Browns Ferry Unit 1 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Browns Ferry Unit 2 Returns After Six-Year Shutdown
pins.evidence: Unit 2 returns in May 1991, ahead of Units 3 and 1. The reactor database supplies the May 24 grid/restart marker.

pins.title: Browns Ferry Unit 3 Returns After Ten-Year Shutdown
pins.evidence: Unit 3 returns in November 1995. Day 1 follows the database marker and month-only issuer account; it is not asserted as an exact commercial restart day.

pins.title: TVA Approves Browns Ferry Unit 1 Recovery
pins.evidence: TVA’s board approves returning Unit 1, idle since 1985. May 1 is a month-only anchor.

pins.title: Browns Ferry Unit 1 Returns to Commercial Operation After 22 Years
pins.evidence: Commercial operation returns August 1, after pre-commercial operations began June 2. The September 2008 Inspector General review reports approximately USD 1.84 billion project cost through FY2007, with subsequent credits described separately.

pins.title: Sequoyah Unit 1 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Sequoyah Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: The second unit enters commercial service before TVA’s subsequent station recovery period.

pins.title: Sequoyah Unit 2 Returns During TVA Nuclear Recovery
pins.evidence: The original TVA records place Unit 2’s return in May 1988; an exact day is not claimed.

pins.title: Sequoyah Unit 1 Returns During TVA Nuclear Recovery
pins.evidence: Unit 1 returns in November 1988, completing Sequoyah’s recovery from the 1985 shutdown. Day 1 is a month-only anchor.

pins.title: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Unit 6 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: TEPCO Starts Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Unit 6 Reactor After Nearly 14 Years
pins.evidence: Control-rod withdrawal begins the reactor restart; a control-rod monitoring alarm interrupts the process January 22. This is separate from commercial return.

pins.title: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Unit 6 Resumes Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: TEPCO resumes commercial operation at 16:00 Japan time after regulatory inspection certificates. Net rating 1,315 MWe; 1,356 MWe is gross.

pins.title: Onagawa Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Onagawa Unit 2 Begins Its Post-Fukushima Reactor Restart
pins.evidence: Reactor startup begins after safety upgrades; subsequent checks and equipment interruptions precede sustained commercial return.

pins.title: Onagawa Unit 2 Reconnects to the Grid
pins.evidence: Power generation and grid connection resume at 18:00 Japan time; commercial service remains a later milestone.

pins.title: Onagawa Unit 2 Returns to Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation resumes at 16:00 Japan time after final checks. Electrical rating is 796 MWe net / 825 MWe gross.

pins.title: Shimane Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Shimane Unit 2 Restarts Its Reactor After Nearly 13 Years
pins.evidence: The reactor starts at 15:00 Japan time and reaches criticality at 16:50. Reactor startup is distinct from grid reconnection and commercial service.

pins.title: Shimane Unit 2 Resumes Grid Generation
pins.evidence: Chugoku’s results distinguish this generator synchronization from the December 7 reactor startup and January 10 commercial return.

pins.title: Shimane Unit 2 Resumes Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: The operator confirms commercial return after receipt of the regulator’s inspection certificate. Net electrical rating 789 MWe; gross 820 MWe.

pins.title: Bruce A Unit 1 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Bruce Power Agrees to Refurbish and Restart Units 1 and 2
pins.evidence: The Ontario agreement supports refurbishment and restart. Only 2005 is established in this history; January 1 is an estimated year anchor.

pins.title: Bruce A Unit 1 Reconnects After Fifteen-Year Layup
pins.evidence: Unit 1 supplies the grid following refurbishment; subsequent commercial-service milestones remain separate.

pins.title: Bruce A Unit 2 Reconnects After Seventeen-Year Layup
pins.evidence: Unit 2 returns to the grid, bringing the pair back after lengthy layups.

pins.title: Bruce A Completes the Two-Unit Restart Programme
pins.evidence: Both refurbished units reach commercial service by November 2012. This pin covers the combined programme; day 1 is a month-level anchor.

pins.title: Metsamor Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Armenia Decides to Restart Metsamor Unit 2 Amid an Energy Crisis
pins.evidence: A severe energy shortage leads to a restart decision. Only the year is established; January 1 is an estimated timeline anchor.

pins.title: Metsamor Unit 2 Restarts After Six-and-a-Half-Year Closure
pins.evidence: The operator dates Unit 2’s restart to November 5. Unit 1 remains shut; later uprates and life extensions are different projects.

pins.title: Embalse Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Embalse Shuts for Reactor Retubing and Life Extension
pins.evidence: The CANDU unit enters a multiyear programme including fuel-channel and steam-generator replacement.

pins.title: Embalse Achieves Criticality After Three-Year Refurbishment
pins.evidence: The refurbished reactor reaches criticality, followed by testing and power ascension before commercial return.

pins.title: Embalse Resumes Commercial Operation After Life Extension
pins.evidence: Commercial service returns after several months of tests; regulator reports 683 MW gross following uprating, distinct from historical net reference ratings.

pins.title: Maanshan Unit 1 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Maanshan Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: The second pressurized-water reactor enters commercial service.

pins.title: Taipower Submits Maanshan Restart and Licence-Renewal Application
pins.evidence: The regulator receives the application; submission does not authorize generation.

pins.title: Taiwan Completes Review of Maanshan Restart Plan
pins.evidence: The restart-plan review is completed; onsite verification, aging, seismic and other requirements remain before operating permission.

pins.title: Maanshan Restart Discussed for 2028 at the Earliest
pins.evidence: Reporting describes a conditional earliest-year prospect. December 31 is an estimated year marker; neither unit is treated as already restarted.

pins.title: Kuosheng Unit 1 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: Kuosheng Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: The second boiling-water reactor enters commercial service.

pins.title: Taiwan Reopens the Path to a Kuosheng Nuclear Restart
pins.evidence: The economics ministry approves feasibility work in November 2025; this is a policy/project step, not authority to operate. Day 1 is a month-only anchor.

pins.title: Kuosheng Restart Planning Continues as Taiwan Revisits Nuclear Power
pins.evidence: September reporting discusses Kuosheng alongside Maanshan. Sources conflict on whether Kuosheng formally filed a restart application in March; this pin records the dated planning report, not a verified regulatory submission or operating approval.

pins.title: Kori Unit 2 Begins Commercial Operation
pins.evidence: Commercial operation begins. This dates the original generating unit, before the later shutdown and recovery described in this thread.

pins.title: South Korea Approves Continued Operation of Kori Unit 2
pins.evidence: The regulator approves operation through 2033 in November 2025; day 1 is an estimated month anchor and does not date the eventual restart.

pins.title: Kori Unit 2 Restarts After Three-Year Licence-Renewal Shutdown

pins.evidence: Three Mile Island’s second reactor enters commercial service, less than three months before its 1979 accident.

pins.evidence: Crane restoration is under way but generating restart remains conditional; completing a loan or regulatory step does not complete the restart.

pins.evidence: Crane restoration is under way but generating restart remains conditional; completing a loan or regulatory step does not complete the restart.

pins.evidence: Crane restoration is under way but generating restart remains conditional; completing a loan or regulatory step does not complete the restart.
